mapper.select: SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(c.sched_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || c.sched_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS sched_date , c.sche_method FROM members a ,schedule_creation b ,schedule_details c WHERE a.mem_id = b.mem_id AND b.schedule_id = c.schedule_id AND a.mem_id = #{memId} AND b.use_yn ='Y'
